Situated in Shanghai, the company benefits from a highly developed business environment, strong logistics infrastructure, and access to a wide network of research institutions, industrial partners, and global customers. Meryer’s location in Minhang also places it within a district known for its industrial activity and connection to Shanghai’s growing technology ecosystem.

They often contribute by offering specialized chemicals, laboratory materials, and technical support that help customers accelerate discovery and production. Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd., as part of this dynamic industry, represents the kind of modern Chinese chemical company that serves both domestic and international markets through science-driven solutions and reliable industrial support.
